entries.en: A table and a first order
Greet the staff, ask for a table, and order one item politely.
Good afternoon. How many people?
Good afternoon. How many people are there?
Good afternoon. A table for two, please.
Two.
Good afternoon. A coffee, please.
Could you repeat that more slowly?
Of course. Here are your menus.
Of course. Here is the menu.
Thank you. How much is an americano?
How much?
Thank you. Where is the restroom?
Could you repeat that more slowly?
It costs thirty-five pesos.
Thirty-five pesos.
An americano, please.
Coffee.
Thirty-five pesos, please.
Could you repeat that more slowly?
Anything else?
Would you like anything else?
No, thank you. That is all for now.
No.
You're welcome.
Could you repeat that more slowly?
Alrighty I will bring it to you right away!
Tacos, toppings, and takeout
Specify quantities, request a change, and ask for repetition.
Hello. What would you like to order?
Hello. What are you going to have?
Could I have two al pastor tacos and a hibiscus drink, please?
Two al pastor tacos. A hibiscus drink.
Could I have the bill, please?
Could you repeat that more slowly?
Of course. With onion and cilantro?
Do you want them with onion and with cilantro?
With onion, but without cilantro. Is the salsa very spicy?
No cilantro.
Nice to meet you.
Could you repeat that more slowly?
The red one is. Would you like the green one on the side?
The red salsa is spicy. Shall I put the green salsa in a separate container?
Yes, on the side, please. Everything to go.
Yes. To go.
Yes, please. A table for two.
Could you repeat that more slowly?
Perfect. Two al pastor without cilantro, a hibiscus drink, and the green salsa on the side. That's ninety pesos.
Find an alternative within budget
Explain a preference and choose another option when something runs out.
Good afternoon. Do you know what you'd like to order?
Good afternoon. What can I bring you?
Yes. I would like two chicken tacos and a café de olla.
Give me two chicken tacos and a café de olla.
Yes, I already paid, thanks.
Could you repeat that more slowly?
Sorry, we have run out of chicken. We have al pastor and cactus tacos.
There's no more chicken. We have al pastor or cactus tacos.
I don't eat pork. Do the cactus tacos have meat or cheese?
No pork. Cactus meat?
Great! Two chicken ones, please.
Could you repeat that more slowly?
At this café, they don't. They have cactus, onion, and cilantro.
They have no meat or cheese. Just cactus, onion, and cilantro.
Then two cactus tacos. I have one hundred pesos. Do I have enough for the coffee too?
Two cactus. A hundred pesos is good?
Then two cactus tacos. I am one hundred years old.
Could you repeat that more slowly?
Yes. The tacos cost fifty and the coffee is forty. That's ninety pesos.
Yes, you have enough. Fifty plus forty: ninety pesos.
Perfect. Does the coffee already come sweetened?
Coffee with sugar?
Perfect. That's one hundred ninety pesos, right?
Could you repeat that more slowly?
Yes, we make it with piloncillo and cinnamon. Enjoy your meal!
Fix an order and check the bill
Correct a misunderstanding politely and explain a mistake on the bill.
Here are your tacos. Enjoy your meal!
Your tacos are here. Enjoy them!
Excuse me, we had ordered two chicken tacos, one without cilantro. Both have cilantro.
Hey, this is wrong. Both have cilantro.
Excuse me, we ordered two tacos without chicken.
Could you repeat that more slowly?
You're right. I'll replace one. Is everything else all right?
Sorry. I'll bring you another taco without cilantro. Is everything else okay?
Yes, thank you. We also ordered two hibiscus drinks.
Yes. And the drinks.
No, thanks. We didn't order anything else.
Could you repeat that more slowly?
Here they are. The bill is one hundred forty-six pesos.
It's one hundred forty-six pesos in total.
Could you check it? The two tacos are fifty-six and the two drinks are sixty. I get one hundred sixteen.
It's wrong. It's one hundred sixteen.
Perfect, here's one hundred forty-six.
Could you repeat that more slowly?
That's right; I charged for one extra drink. I'll fix it now.
You're right, I charged an extra drink. I'll fix it right away.
Thanks for checking. Can we pay separately, one taco and one drink each?
We pay separate.
Thanks for checking. Can we pay separately, two tacos each?
Could you repeat that more slowly?
Of course. That's fifty-eight pesos per person.
Negotiate a plan for the group
Balance everyone's needs, propose alternatives, and confirm the agreement.
Good afternoon, welcome to Café La Esquina. How can I help you?
Welcome. What do you need?
We are four University of Florida students. We have thirty minutes before we leave. Would it be possible to eat here without running late?
We're four. We're in a hurry. We want to eat fast here.
We are four University of Florida students. Could you bring us the bill, please?
Could you repeat that more slowly?
I only have a table for two. If you wait about fifteen minutes, I could put two tables together.
Right now there's only a table for two. In about fifteen minutes I'll put two tables together for you.
We would rather not risk it. If we ordered to go, how long would it take?
We don't want to wait. To go how much time?
We would rather take the risk. We'll wait an hour.
Could you repeat that more slowly?
Between ten and twelve minutes, as long as you choose chicken or cactus.
If you order chicken or cactus tacos, they're ready in ten or twelve minutes.
That works for us. We would like four chicken tacos, four cactus tacos, and four hibiscus drinks. Of the chicken tacos, two without cilantro.
Ok. Four chicken, four cactus, four hibiscus. Two no cilantro.
That works for us. We would like eight al pastor tacos, please.
Could you repeat that more slowly?
All right. Shall I pack them separately?
Very well. Do you want the tacos in separate packages?
Yes, in packages of two. I would appreciate it if you labeled the ones without cilantro. If there were a delay, would you let us know?
Yes, in packages of two. I would appreciate it if you label the ones without cilantro.
No, everything together in one bag, and all with cilantro.
Could you repeat that more slowly?
Of course. That's four packages of two tacos and four drinks, all to go. The total is three hundred thirty-two pesos.
